items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1961-04-07
items.q: him and I was together on the Strait for the Boat together, you see. We worked together on the boat.

ctx.x: Did he talk you into doing that or why did you?
Yeah, he did, he had been up to Lyon a long time, you know. And when he come back, of course, him and I was together on the Strait for the Boat together, you see. We worked together on the boat.
